cellReadings.reason: The frozen React and Next.js adapters publish no target-cell package registry, so no per-package verdict exists for this lineage. Every declared dependency is unknown to the engine rather than accepted by it.

notEstablished: Detection reads declarations. Nothing here establishes that this application installs, compiles, builds, or behaves as it did on its era toolchain.
A cell verdict is a reading of a published registry, not an installation: a range written here has not been resolved against any lockfile by this record.
A dependency the cell has no reading for is reported `unknown`. `unknown` is not `supported` and it is not `unsupported`.
